subject: Live Labs series: Olive Analytics + Redwood — logistics & draft schedule
messages:
From: Kate Martin <kate@oliveanalytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 09:26:00 -0700
Subject: Live labs series idea — hands-on sessions with Olive + Redwood

Hi Marcus and Soojin,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Olive Analytics is seeing strong interest from customers who want more than a slide deck — they want guided, hands-on labs that walk engineers through integrating models into their apps and measuring latency/cost in production.

We think a 3-part "Live Labs" series co-hosted with Redwood would hit that need:
- Session 1 (60m): Faststart integration (API auth, model selection, test harness)
- Session 2 (60m): Performance tuning & cost controls (batching, KV cache)
- Session 3 (60m): Production checklist & monitoring (rollouts, SLA considerations)

High-level ask: co-hosted events, each with a 30–40 minute demo + 20–30 minute hands-on breakouts where attendees follow along in a sandbox. Olive can provide sandbox infra and a simple dataset.

Questions for you:
1) Does this format make sense for Redwood?
2) Any target date windows in June/July?
3) What level of promotional support would Redwood ideally provide (emails, paid ads, social)?

I attached a short one-pager with a sample audience and estimated audience size (~400 registrants across the series).

Attachments: olive-proposal-summary.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

Best,
Kate Martin
Partnerships — Olive Analytics
kate@oliveanalytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kate Martin <kate@oliveanalytics.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Live labs series idea — hands-on sessions with Olive + Redwood

Kate — this sounds great and aligned with the kind of content our users ask for. Thanks for the one-pager.

Quick answers:
- Format: Agreed on the 60m + breakouts approach. Redwood can provide a short pre-built demo repo and a disposable API key flow for attendees to use in breakouts.
- Timing: June 26 / July 10 / July 24 could work on our side (Tuesdays). Do any of those align with Olive's calendar?
- Promo: We can commit to two targeted mailers (one to product integrations and one to platform eng lists), social posts, and a small paid LinkedIn boost if Olive co-funds.

Operational asks from us:
1) Audience profile (SE vs SRE vs Data Eng split) so we can route sign-ups appropriately.
2) Lead handling — what lead fields will Olive capture, and what's the handoff SLA?
3) Joint slide deck and run-of-show by one week before each session.

Looping in Ben and Laura to sync on promo and webinar ops. Happy to jump on a 30-min sync next week if that helps.

Thanks — I like this a lot.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Field Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Kate Martin <kate@oliveanalytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 May 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Live labs series idea — hands-on sessions with Olive + Redwood

Thanks Marcus and Kate — putting a few pragmatic items on the table so we can scope ops: 

1) Lead sharing: Redwood prefers to receive MQLs within 48 hours via HubSpot API and Olive retains source tags. Is this acceptable?
2) Recording & content: We're fine with recordings being gated, but we ask for a short summary clip (3–5 min) that Redwood can reuse for demand gen.
3) Breakouts: If Olive will provide sandbox infra, can you confirm concurrent seat limits (we typically expect 80–120 live breakout participants).
4) Budget: For paid promotion we typically look for a modest co-fund ($3k–$7k depending on audience targeting).

Proposed draft schedule (to stitch into your one-pager):
- Tue Jun 26 10:00 AM PT — Session 1: Faststart integration
- Tue Jul 10 10:00 AM PT — Session 2: Tuning & cost controls
- Tue Jul 24 10:00 AM PT — Session 3: Production checklist

If those dates work, I'll ask ops to reserve the webinar page and start creating the joint run-of-show template. Also adding a HubSpot deal: HUB-4891 so we can track co-funded spend and expected leads.

Thanks,
Soojin
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kate Martin <kate@oliveanalytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Live labs series idea — hands-on sessions with Olive + Redwood

Kate — Ben from Field Marketing here. A couple operational points from promo side:

- Assets we need from Olive by 1 June: high-res logo (SVG), two headshots of presenters, 1–2 short speaker bios (50–75 words), and any customer quotes.
- CTA / registration flow: Prefer two CTAs — "Register for the full series" and "Request an enterprise consult". Will you be able to support both on the registration form?
- Paid promotion: We'll run a $1k LinkedIn boost. If Olive can co-fund $2k, we can expand to a second boost targeted at platform engs.
- Tracking: We'll use UTM tags and share a post-event lead export. Please confirm GDPR-compliant consent text for EU registrants if you expect any EU traffic.

Attaching our promo kit with email templates and a sample landing page so you can see our cadence.

Attachments: redwood-promo-kit.zip (ZIP, 1.1MB)

If it helps, let's do a 30-min ops check next Thursday (28 May) to confirm assets and the registration page.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sr. Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Kate Martin <kate@oliveanalytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Live labs series idea — hands-on sessions with Olive + Redwood

Hi team — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear asks. Olive is on board with the proposed dates (Jun 26 / Jul 10 / Jul 24).

Quick answers:
- Audience split: We'll aim for ~60% SE / 25% Data Eng / 15% SRE.
- Lead capture: We'll capture name, company, role, email, and consent checkbox. Olive will push leads to Redwood HubSpot via the API within 24 hours.
- Sandbox capacity: We can support up to 150 concurrent breakout seats; we'll stage load tests in the week before each session.
- Budget: Olive can co-fund $6k total (suggest $2k per session) toward paid promotion — happy to route via the HubSpot deal.

Attached: final-schedule.pdf (PDF, 140KB), SOW-draft.docx (DOCX, 56KB). We'll review Ben's promo kit and deliver assets by 1 June.

Next step: Marcus / Soojin — can you confirm the 28 May ops check meeting? If that works, we'll send a calendar invite and send presenter materials shortly after.

Thanks — excited to get this running.

— Kate
Kate Martin
Partnerships — Olive Analytics
kate@oliveanalytics.com
Attachments: final-schedule.pdf, SOW-draft.docx
